title: MV Triggering day and night system

posts.author: Vixianyalia
posts.body: Hi, sorry if this is in the wrong forum but I figured it fit this one best. I don't have much experience with the RPG Maker MV, so my wording and terms might be a bit off. I'm trying to make it so whenever my character interacts with the bed, they hop on it and it turns to night time and when they interact again, it turns to day time. But I think I've made everything quite complicated for myself, cause my other maps don't comply with what i have coded. I have tried to look up how to fix this issue and tried to make some common events, but I haven't quite understood them that well and haven't found a tutorial that could help me with this specific problem. Big thanks in advance.

posts.author: inc0der
posts.body: You should show us what you already have so we can help you further, you may be very close, but we will never know

posts.author: CapLegHole
posts.body:
The day night cycle should just be a common event that checks a variable for a 1 or a 0 (day or night) and then flips it to the other number. Then all of your maps that are affected just need to check if the variable is on day or night and run the changes accordingly.
There shouldn't need to be a plugin unless it controls some pretty complicated stuff, but that would be pretty specific per game.
